description: Tiered community memberships: recurring subscriptions, a product catalogue, and access to member spaces.

curator_fields.justification: Which membership tier this person holds — gates access grants and pricing.
Lifecycle state (active/grace/lapsed/cancelled) — drives access sync and renewal machinery.
Next renewal date — drives reminders and the grace/lapse sweep.

deactivation: Member records, tiers and products stay in place (soft state); access sync stops. Reactivation resumes where it left off.
